items.title: Original files carry the most weight when AI is suspected in a claim
items.summary: Insurers investigating AI-generated fraudulent evidence are relying on forensic document reports, with legal and claims experts stressing the vital importance of preserving original files and metadata.

items.title: Lloyd's is far sharper than it was, but a little less collective
items.summary: Richard Wood of Westfield Specialty reflects on 40 years at Lloyd's, noting how technology has made the market sharper and more transactional while eroding some of its traditional face-to-face camaraderie.

items.title: Tax insurance emerges as a tool to accelerate alternative investment fund wind-downs
items.summary: Alternative asset managers are using tax liability insurance to mitigate contingent tax risks and shorten the time required to close older funds.

items.title: Cyberattacks on operational technology can trigger multiple insurance policies, AXA XL warns
items.summary: A new report from AXA XL examines how cyber incidents targeting operational technology can disrupt physical processes without damaging machinery and affect multiple lines of cover.

items.title: Aviation claims, legal services and property treaty appointments announced across insurance market
items.summary: A series of senior appointments across underwriting, claims and branch management features moves at HIVE Underwriters, Intact, Howden Retirement, Canopius, Arch and Caytons.

items.title: James Baird launches Summit Risk Partners to target delegated authority post-bind gap
items.summary: Former Consilium co-CEO James Baird has launched registered Lloyd's broker Summit Risk Partners, backed by K2 Insurance Services, to focus on ongoing programme management.
